etsy.description:
Forgot to move the elf again? Someone touched it? Your big kid asks if it's real? There's a letter for that. 🎄

Elf Lifesaver Letters is a stack of 30 ready-to-print notes for every December moment, so you never have to write one at 11 p.m. again. Just add your child's name and leave it next to your elf.

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (13 pages)
• Arrival letters: first visit and "I'm back!"
• Lifesaver letters: running late, someone touched me, staying put, snowy day, rest day, someone is sick, we're traveling, sorry about the mess, early goodbye
• Kindness and feelings notes: kindness challenge, giving day, thank you for being brave, my favorite thing about you
• Fun notes: I brought a friend, I lost my hat, a letter for Santa, bedtime helper
• Santa's mid-December report
• Christmas Eve goodbye and "see you next year"
• 2 gentle "big kid" letters for when they ask if it's real
• 1 blank letter + elf survival plan for parents

👧👦 Best for ages 3 to 10. Works with any toy you already have.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included. Print at home on paper or card stock.

PLEASE NOTE
"Christmas Elf" is a generic name for this activity. Not affiliated with any elf doll brand: use any toy you already have. For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
